module_summary: Dual-clock AXI-stream FIFO: write side stores packed beats in a RAM indexed by a binary write pointer, Gray-coded pointers cross clock domains through synchronizers for full/empty, and a RAM pipeline feeds the output, with optional frame drop/mark and status reporting.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: FIFO RAM of packed beats, written at wr_ptr_reg, read at rd_ptr_reg

anchors.name: wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: binary write pointer addressing mem on s_clk

anchors.name: rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: binary read pointer addressing mem on m_clk

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: input beat valid; with tready triggers write

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: input ready from full flag, drop modes and reset sync

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: input payload packed into s_axis word for mem

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: output valid from RAM pipeline last stage

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: output ready advancing pipeline and read pointer

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: output payload from pipeline output

anchors.name: wr_ptr_gray_reg
anchors.why: Gray-coded write pointer synchronized into m_clk; compared for full

anchors.name: rd_ptr_gray_reg
anchors.why: Gray-coded read pointer synchronized into s_clk; compared for empty

anchors.name: wr_ptr_gray_sync2_reg
anchors.why: write pointer after two-flop sync into m_clk, used for empty

anchors.name: rd_ptr_gray_sync2_reg
anchors.why: read pointer after two-flop sync into s_clk, used for full

anchors.name: full
anchors.why: full compare of Gray pointers; gates s_axis_tready and drop/mark

anchors.name: empty
anchors.why: empty compare; blocks read pointer increment

anchors.name: full_wr
anchors.why: frame overflow (write vs commit pointer); frame FIFO mode only

anchors.name: wr_ptr_commit_reg
anchors.why: committed write pointer at frame boundary; rollback target on drop

anchors.name: drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: dropping current input frame; suppresses writes until tlast

anchors.name: mark_frame_reg
anchors.why: marks frame bad when full (MARK_WHEN_FULL mode), forces tlast/tuser

anchors.name: send_frame_reg
anchors.why: oversize frame being streamed through without drop (frame FIFO mode)

anchors.name: s_frame_reg
anchors.why: input mid-frame tracker for reset drop and marking

anchors.name: m_axis_pipe_reg
anchors.why: RAM read pipeline stages carrying beats to output

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe_reg
anchors.why: per-stage valid chain advancing RAM pipeline

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_pipe
anchors.why: internal ready of pipeline output; advances stages

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid_pipe
anchors.why: internal valid of last pipeline stage

anchors.name: m_frame_reg
anchors.why: output mid-frame tracker for terminating frames on source reset

anchors.name: m_drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: stalls reads and requests frame termination after source reset

anchors.name: m_terminate_frame_reg
anchors.why: forces tlast and bad tuser on terminated output frame

anchors.name: wr_ptr_update_reg
anchors.why: toggle request syncing commit pointer to m_clk (frame FIFO)

anchors.name: wr_ptr_update_ack_sync2_reg
anchors.why: synchronized ack of commit pointer update toggle

anchors.name: s_status_depth
anchors.why: write-side occupancy output from s_depth_reg

anchors.name: m_status_depth
anchors.why: read-side occupancy output from m_depth_reg

anchors.name: s_status_overflow
anchors.why: write-side frame overflow/drop pulse

anchors.name: m_status_overflow
anchors.why: overflow pulse toggled across to m_clk

groups.name: Write controller
groups.description: s_clk write pointer, full detection, frame drop/mark/commit logic

groups.name: FIFO RAM
groups.description: Dual-clock RAM of packed AXI-stream beats

groups.name: Clock-domain crossing
groups.description: Gray pointer and commit-toggle synchronizers between s_clk and m_clk

groups.name: Read pipeline
groups.description: m_clk read pointer, empty check and RAM output pipeline with frame termination

groups.name: Status reporting
groups.description: Depth counters and overflow/bad/good frame pulses in both domains
